https://www.nature.com/articles/nature14: Original DQN: preserve replay, target network and Bellman target; not a claim of successful landing.
https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/inter: Independent CartPole tutorial-style reference: separate deque, optimizer, targets and soft updates; adapted headlessly with shared budget and explicit RNG.
https://gymnasium.farama.org/tutorials/g: Distinguish physical termination from external truncation, identify missing clock for a finite-horizon interpretation; no unsupported attribution of observed failures to timeouts.
https://arxiv.org/abs/1704.03732: Motivates combining demonstrations, TD, supervised margin and n-step targets; our version uses fixed stratification, CE warmstart and no PER, so not exact DQfD.
https://arxiv.org/abs/1509.06461: Double DQN: principal network selects, target evaluates. Transfer only after DQN showed useful greedy behaviour.
